title: Carbonite Sports
description: Carbonite Sports is the official spring and fall league partner of River Falls Girls Flag Football. Players are encouraged to use Carbonite Sports seasons to gain experience, strengthen fundamentals, and prepare for club tournament competition. Carbonite registration and fees are separate from the River Falls Girls Flag Football summer club program.

title: Travel Club
description: Teams will compete in 3-5 summer tournaments, including NFL FLAG regionals. The schedule will be selected based on available age divisions, quality of competition, team readiness, travel demands, and overall cost to families.

title: Compete regionally
description: Club teams compete in approximately three to five regional tournaments, including NFL FLAG regional opportunities when appropriate.

title: 1% better every day
description: Teams will practice 1-2 times per week ahead of tournament play during the summer club segment. Practices are where coaches teach, players experiment, and the team prepares. Games are where players have the freedom to trust their preparation and play. Mistakes will happen in both settings; our job is to learn from them and move confidently to the next play.
